At 0.1C, the reversible capacity is 700 mAh/gS. At 1C, the reversible capacity is 370 mAh/gS. 

To calculate the share of the 0.1C reversible capacity that is retained at 1C, we can divide the 1C reversible capacity by the 0.1C reversible capacity and multiply by 100.

(370 mAh/gS / 700 mAh/gS) * 100 = 52.86%

So, approximately 52.86% of the 0.1C reversible capacity is retained at 1C.
